request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: On 1 March 2027 a manufacturer places a machine on the market with the instructions for use in digital format; at the time of purchase the user asks for the instructions on paper. Within what time must the manufacturer provide them free of charge?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store has no answer of its own.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- manufacturer, paper instructions | has obligation | provide the instructions for use in paper format free of charge | if: at the request of the user at the time of the purchase | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "However, at the request of the user at the time of the purchase, the manufacturer shall provide the instructions for use in paper format free of charge within one month."
- manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | present them in a format that makes it possible for the user… | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "(b) present them in a format that makes it possible for the user to print and download the instructions for use and save them on an electronic device so that he or she can access them at all times, in particular during a breakdown of the machinery or related product;"
- Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."
- manufacturer | has obligation | provide the assembly instructions in paper format free of charge within one… | if: at the request of the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery at the time of purchase | [REG, Art. 11(7)] | sentence: "However, at the request of the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery at the time of purchase, the manufacturer shall provide the assembly instructions in paper format free of charge within one month."
- manufacturer, non-professional users | has obligation | provide, in paper format… | if: in the case of machinery intended for non-professional users or that can be used by non-professional users | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "In the case of machinery or a related product intended for non-professional users or that can, under reasonably foreseeable conditions, be used by non-professional users, even if not intended for them, the manufacturer shall provide, in paper format, the safety information that is essential for putting the machinery or related product into service and for using it in a safe way."
- manufacturer | has obligation | present them in a format that makes it possible | if: When the assembly instructions are provided in digital format | [REG, Art. 11(7)] | sentence: "When the assembly instructions are provided in digital format, the manufacturer shall: (a) mark on the partly completed machinery, or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document, how to access the digital assembly instructions; (b) present them in a format that makes it possible for the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery to print and download th"
- costruttore di un macchinario | has obligation | fornire in formato cartaceo le istruzioni per l'uso sicuro | [univpm-guideline, p. 7] | sentence: "Con l’entrata in vigore della Direttiva Macchine 2006/42/CE il costruttore di un macchinario è obbligato a fornire in formato cartaceo le istruzioni per l'uso sicuro."
- manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | mark on the machinery or related product | if: where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "(a) mark on the machinery or related product, or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or in an accompanying document, how to access the digital instructions;"
- manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | clearly describe the product model | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "Such instructions and information shall clearly describe the product model to which they correspond."
- fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4] | sentence: "b) dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente rispettivamente, nei confronti del fabbricante ovvero dei soggetti della catena della distribuzione, qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura ad uno o più requisiti essenziali di sicurezza previsti dalle disposizioni legi"
- manufacturer | has obligation | this requirement also applies | if: where the assembly instructions are embedded in the software of the partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 11(7)] | sentence: "this requirement also applies where the assembly instructions are embedded in the software of the partly completed machinery;"
- manufacturers | has obligation | shall provide the internet address or machine readable code | if: alternatively to accompanying the declaration, where it can be accessed in the assembly instructions set out in Annex XI | [REG, Art. 11(8)] | sentence: "Manufacturers shall ensure that the partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine readable code where that EU declaration of incorporation can be accessed in the assembly instructions set out in Annex XI."
- digital instructions, manufacturer | retention period | make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) | if: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product | [REG, Art. 10(7)] | sentence: "(c) make them accessible online during the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product and for at least 10 years after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product."

response.text: {"reasoning": "Article 10(7) of the Machinery Regulation requires the manufacturer, at the user's request at the time of purchase, to provide the instructions for use in paper format free of charge within one month. Article 54 says the Regulation applies from 20 January 2027, and the corrigendum (point 10) changed the date from 14 to 20 January 2027. Placing on the market on 1 March 2027 is after that date, so the obligation applies, and the time limit is one month.", "kind": "duration", "value": "P1M", "text": "Under Article 10(7) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, as applicable from 20 January 2027 per the corrigendum, the manufacturer must provide paper instructions free of charge within one month of the user's purchase-time request.", "evidence": [{"file": "REG.md", "quote": "However, at the request of the user at the time of the purchase, the manufacturer shall provide the instructions for use in paper format free of charge within one month."}, {"file": "REG.md", "quote": "It shall apply from 20 January 2027."}, {"file": "CORR.md", "quote": "On page 39, Article 54, second paragraph: for: ‘ 14 January 2027 ’, read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."}]}
